body.label: Effect
body.html: Until the start of your next turn, the first close-range Action that targets you suffers -1 die.

surges.html: You or one adjacent ally gains +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.
After this resolves, your next 2 units of movement this turn do not trigger Reactions.

rider.title: GUARD — STANCE
rider.html: Enter Black Tortoise Stance. While in this Stance, gain +1 Defense against the first Action that targets you each round. Entering another Stance replaces it; becoming Prone ends it.
